entities.summary: Matthias Buchinger, sometimes called Matthew Buckinger in English, was a German artist, magician, calligrapher, and performer who was born without hands or feet and was 2 ft 5 in (74 cm) tall. Buchinger was especially noted for his micrography, in which illustrations consist of very small text.
